searchText: Martin setup the crawler for Holesky, so DNS based discovery should be supported for Holesky: https://github.com/eth-clients/holesky/pull/86 e,g: `dig all.holesky.ethdisco.net ANY`

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Martin setup the crawler for Holesky, so DNS based discovery should be supported for Holesky: https://github.com/eth-clients/holesky/pull/86
e,g: `dig all.holesky.ethdisco.net ANY`
